meaning:
συν-αγωνίζομαι
to strive together with, to help (prop., of sharing in a contest): with dative of person(s) and of thing(s), Rom.15:30.†
(AS)

renderings.bsb: to join me in my struggle

elsewhere.note: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,
